name: Proverbs
lede: The twentieth book of the Bible, in full: a father's instruction to his son, Wisdom crying aloud at the gates and building her house of seven pillars, the proverbs of Solomon one by one, the words of the wise, the sayings copied out by the men of Hezekiah, the words of Agur and of king Lemuel, and the worthy woman, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Beginning of Knowledge
books.blurb: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David — the fear of Jehovah is the beginning of knowledge; my son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not; Wisdom crieth aloud in the street: how long, ye simple ones?; if thou seek her as silver; trust in Jehovah with all thy heart; she is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her.

books.name: Get Wisdom
books.blurb: Hear, my sons, the instruction of a father — for I was a son unto my father; wisdom is the principal thing, therefore get wisdom; the path of the righteous is as the dawning light; keep thy heart with all diligence; drink waters out of thine own cistern; go to the ant, thou sluggard; six things which Jehovah hateth, yea, seven; for the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light.

books.name: Wisdom Hath Builded Her House
books.blurb: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; at the window of my house I looked forth, and beheld a young man void of understanding in the twilight; doth not wisdom cry? — by me kings reign; Jehovah possessed me in the beginning of his way, when he set a circle upon the face of the deep; Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars; stolen waters are sweet.

books.name: A Wise Son
books.blurb: The proverbs of Solomon, one by one: a wise son maketh a glad father; the hand of the diligent maketh rich; the mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life; hatred stirreth up strifes, but love covereth all transgressions; a false balance is an abomination to Jehovah; as a ring of gold in a swine's snout; a worthy woman is the crown of her husband.

books.name: A Tree of Life
books.blurb: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick, but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life; the law of the wise is a fountain of life; every wise woman buildeth her house; where no oxen are, the crib is clean; a soft answer turneth away wrath; the eyes of Jehovah are in every place; better is a dinner of herbs, where love is.

books.name: The Lot Is Cast into the Lap
books.blurb: Commit thy works unto Jehovah; a just balance and scales are Jehovah's; pride goeth before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall; pleasant words are as a honeycomb; the lot is cast into the lap, but the whole disposing thereof is of Jehovah; better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith; the name of Jehovah is a strong tower.

books.name: The King's Heart
books.blurb: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity; the king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping; wine is a mocker, strong drink a brawler; diverse weights are an abomination to Jehovah; the spirit of man is the lamp of Jehovah; the king's heart is in the hand of Jehovah as the watercourses; the horse is prepared against the day of battle, but victory is of Jehovah.

books.name: The Words of the Wise
books.blurb: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches; train up a child in the way he should go; incline thine ear, and hear the words of the wise; remove not the ancient landmark; riches make themselves wings like an eagle; who hath woe? — look not thou upon the wine when it is red; through wisdom is a house builded; a righteous man falleth seven times, and riseth up again; I went by the field of the sluggard.

books.name: Apples of Gold
books.blurb: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out: a word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in network of silver; as cold waters to a thirsty soul; as a dog that returneth to his vomit; as the door turneth upon its hinges, so doth the sluggard upon his bed; iron sharpeneth iron; be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks.

books.name: Bold as a Lion
books.blurb: The wicked flee when no man pursueth, but the righteous are bold as a lion; better is the poor that walketh in his integrity; he that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread; the king by justice establisheth the land; where there is no vision, the people cast off restraint; the fear of man bringeth a snare, but whoso putteth his trust in Jehovah shall be safe.

books.name: A Worthy Woman
books.blurb: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh — who hath ascended up into heaven, and descended?; give me neither poverty nor riches; three things, yea four: the way of an eagle in the air, of a serpent upon a rock, of a ship in the midst of the sea; the ants, the conies, the locusts and the lizard; the words of king Lemuel which his mother taught him; and a worthy woman who can find? — her price is far above rubies; her children rise up, and call her blessed.
